mostWorthwhile.text: Separating the chromosomes and then dividing the cell made two distinct parts of skin renewal clear. The final model connected that small-scale sequence to the whole body.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the three completed examples into the body was predictable, although the insets helped locate each process.

surprise.text: The low-oxygen cue clarified why the kidney sends a signal that increases red-cell production in marrow.

arbitrary.text: The individual pairings had visible purposes, though the order of adding the finished renewal examples felt largely procedural.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it explored a new relationship with a concrete example. This chapter's connections were clear, though some final fitting steps felt repetitive.
